messages.text: A transformer is a neural architecture that uses self-attention instead of recurrence to model sequences.
And why does that beat an LSTM on long context?
Self-attention lets every token see every other token in one step, so the path length does not grow with distance the way a recurrent state does.
Give a short recipe for restaurant risotto.
Toast carnaroli in a dry pan, add warm stock one ladle at a time, stir until the grains go all'onda, then finish off heat with cold butter and parmesan.
Name three rainy-day hikes near Seattle.
Rattlesnake Ledge stays reasonable in drizzle, Twin Falls is better when wet, and the Franklin Falls approach is short, flat, and loud with runoff.
